{{Quote|We think Vader ordered the Noghri to wipe out the Yalarans.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="JKJA" />}}
The '''Yalarans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], yet primitive, [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yalara]]. Unprepared for integration into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was hidden by a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] created by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Broden Kel Verdox]].

==Society and culture==
The Yalarans were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yalara]],<ref name="JKJA" /> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Yalara system/Legends|Yalara system]]</ref> Although [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], Yalarans had only reached a [[Technology level|level]] of technology that was primitive.<ref name="JKJA" />

==History==
[[File:JKAlevelshot_t3_hevil.png|thumb|right|300px|Several Noghri guard the Yalara cloaking device.]]
The Yalarans were a peaceable species with only primitive technology at the [[Time/Legends|time]] that [[Broden Kel Verdox]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] became aware of them, who created a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] to shield their planet from discovery. At some point, a group of [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] traveled to the planet and began guarding the cloaking device.<ref name="JKJA" />

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'' to [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].</ref> [[Tionne Solusar]], a [[Lore Keeper|Jedi scholar]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], learned of the planet through a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Once the Jedi Order became aware that the planet had been discovered by another organization, Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], dispatched [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] to [[Mission to Yalara|investigate]]. There, Korr discovered members of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]]&mdash;a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] hostile to the New Jedi Order&mdash;fighting against the Noghri who were guarding the cloaking device. Korr defeated both groups and finally, warned by Skywalker that the cloaking device could be too powerful to let slip into hostile hands, used [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]] to destroy the device. Skywalker later speculated that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="JKJA" /> a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]],<ref name="Vader DB">{{DB|character|darthvader|Vader, Darth}}</ref> ordered the Noghri to wipe out the Yalarans.<ref name="JKJA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yalarans were created for the backstory of Yalara in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', developed by [[Raven Software]].<ref name="JKJA" />
